ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Portfolio outcome, Follow-on review and later stages need Follow-on reserve and Health.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Active", 1, "Follow-on review", 2, "Exit preparation", 3, "Exit process", 4, "Exited", 5, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Follow_on_reserve__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Health__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Follow-on reserve and Health before moving to Follow-on review.
